hypothesis: Removing distant background texture at identical crop scale and fixed classifier anchor can correct class evidence that is not explained by zoom alone.
selection: First64 images of candidate12's fixed head-held-out list. Per image, at most8 predicted small_all boxes withbaseline score>=0.25 andoriginal width/height<=96. Four lowest aggregate native soft-score normalized top2 gaps, then four highest baseline confidences among remaining boxes. No labels used.
crop: 192x192 original-pixel square centered on each predicted box, outside-image padding114. Identical field of view and960 letterbox in all arms. Keep the centered2x predicted-box rectangle pixel-identical.
interventions: Primary blur: Gaussian31x31 outside kept2x rectangle. Secondary fill:114 outside same rectangle. Original and treatment use the same native classifier anchor chosen on originalcrop bymax(confidence*IoU), IoU>=0.5 to predicted box. Missing anchor means allkeep.
inference: Read native sigmoid class probabilities at fixed anchor; replace original label only when best probability minus original-class probability>0.10 andbestprobability>=0.05. Same condition in every crop arm. Original score/coordinates/order/count remain fixed. No further NMS.
primary: Full64-image small_all recall atconfidence0.25, compared to uniform andmatched raw_crop; allFPPI. Also report owned wrong/correct selected rows, class fixes/losses and trueclass logit margin.
pass_action: Only permits a separately registered train-scene pilot and counterfactual-artifact controls. No large training or official evaluation yet.
budget: At most512 selected crops x3variants=1536 frozen960 patch forwards, batch8, plus warmup/sham identity check. No fitting, threshold selection or test-dev.
prior_art: Contextual debiasing, counterfactual detection, background masking and object-centric crops exist. This screens the specific failure signal for safe class interventions on current frozen final boxes, not a claim of original mechanism.
limits: Previously viewed train scenes, shared historically trained detector. Predicted preserved rectangle includes near context and may be inaccurate. Blur/fill also introduce distribution/boundary changes. Fixed anchor isolates class evidence but ignores regression changes. Diagnostic ignore handling and confidence recall are not official AP. Zoom control is mandatory; fill cannot rescue a failed primary blur.
